text.zh:
热爱视觉设计，主攻电商视觉、IP 形象与平面设计。擅长产品精修、版式策划、AI 创意出图，熟悉从创意构思到成品输出的完整设计流程，兼顾画面质感与商业转化效果。

设计上坚持理性思考搭配感性表达，不盲目堆砌视觉元素，优先挖掘产品亮点，打造适配目标人群的视觉方案。
text.en:
I’m passionate about visual design, with a focus on e-commerce visuals, IP characters and graphic design. My skills include product retouching, layout planning and AI-generated imagery. I work across the full process, from concept to final output, balancing visual quality with commercial conversion.

I combine rational thinking with expressive design. Rather than piling on visual elements, I uncover a product’s strengths and build visual solutions for its target audience.
